gates.description: Business question and success metric must be agreed with stakeholders before modeling
Baseline must be established — model must beat simple heuristics to justify complexity
Fairness analysis must be completed for models that affect people
Model card must be documented (what, why, how, limitations, fairness)
Feature availability at prediction time must be audited — no leakage from future data
Model monitoring must be configured (drift detection, performance tracking, retraining schedule)

anti_patterns.description: Building a model because the technique is interesting — no validated business need
Training with features not available at prediction time — model looks great in dev, fails in production
Great cross-validation scores but no improvement on business metric in A/B testing
Complex model deployed with no explainability — stakeholders can't trust it, bugs can't be debugged
Analysis delivered, model forgotten — no monitoring, no maintenance, no retraining schedule

escalation_triggers: Model shows significant bias against a demographic group
A/B test reveals unexpected negative impact on a business metric
Data quality issues make reliable modeling impossible
Stakeholder wants to deploy model for a use case it was not designed for
Model monitoring detects significant drift with no obvious cause
Privacy-sensitive data required for modeling needs legal/compliance review

input_requirements.description: Spec.md with business question, success metrics, and data availability

output_certifications: Business question and success metric agreed with stakeholders
Fairness analysis completed for models that affect people
Model card documented (what, why, how, limitations, fairness)
No data leakage — feature availability at prediction time audited
Monitoring configured (drift detection, performance tracking, retraining schedule)
